On Mon, Jan 27, 2014 at 6:00 AM, sudhi rao <fors...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I am using R shiny (Windows 7) for developing a dashboard to show the data
> from database as tabular output. I am using the function renderDataTable to
> show the output. I have columns that contains huge numbers (9-10 digits) and
> I want to show these numbers with a comma separation (every three digits). I
> have written a function (format(number,big.mark=",")) that would introduce
> commas every three digits. The output table has commas for the numbers and
> the columns are sortable (Considers them as numbers and sorting as numeric
> columns). But the problem is when I try to host this on a LINUX server the
> sorting doesn't work and sorting is based on alphabetical order (1, 10,11, 2
> ...). Is this a known bug in LINUX version of shiny ? Or am I doing something
> wrong ?
>
> Your help is very much appreciated
